curatedMovie.curiosityHook: A shooter is identified, yet opposing testimonies flatly contradict each other. What really triggered the fatal firefight?
curatedMovie.description: After two North Korean soldiers are killed in the border zone, a neutral Swiss-Korean investigator is sent to probe the shooting, only to confront irreconcilable accounts from both sides.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful procedural carrying heavy geopolitical weight; ideal for focused solitary viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Director Park Chan-wook constructs a tense, somber mystery where a deadly border incident unravels into a thoughtful examination of competing truths.
